title: A withdrawn accusation leaves choice open

captions.energy: Matching expectations to words actually accepted
captions.emotions: Feeling the significance of freely agreeing

meaning: You can discover an accusation’s unsound basis and match expectations to accepted words, feeling the particular significance of an answer given freely.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Tower in the physical position reveals an unsound basis for a reproach. Justice in energy encourages distinguishing words actually accepted from an expectation added to them. The Lovers in emotions bring a sense of significance to freely given agreement. What matters is a genuinely chosen response rather than one obtained after an accusation. Clarification can change the subject itself: a demand to fulfil an alleged promise becomes a question about an actual wish.

For example, “You promised to call after the meeting” proves to be an inference from “I will be free afterwards”. Once this emerges, the earlier reproach loses its basis. **A wanted call does not become a promise by default**. You can explain why a conversation was expected and ask about willingness to speak. Possible agreement feels different because an actual wish supports it. Yet disappointment need not disappear; there is room for it without making distress evidence that a promise was broken.

Another difficulty appears if accuracy is used to recognise only formally promised things as significant. Free agreement then starts sounding like a favour that supposedly cannot be requested. Constructive Justice helps distinguish obligation from desire while preserving room for both. You can reject an invented debt and still take a request seriously; the absence of a promise determines neither the answer nor the value of wanting to talk.
